description: This file defines the CfAudioDeviceModule class, which implements the webrtc::AudioDeviceModule interface and the AudioSource class. It provides an abstraction for audio device functionalities such as initialization, device enumeration, volume control, mute controls, and audio transport control within the WebRTC streaming context, tailored for the Android platform in a Cuttlefish environment.

classes.name: CfAudioDeviceModule
classes.description: A class implementing WebRTC's AudioDeviceModule interface and the AudioSource for audio device management, including device enumeration, initialization, volume and mute controls, and transport management.
